topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text:
Ran into a real head-scratcher today. Some kid walks in, thinking he's got the next big thing—a gadget that could change the game. He's all wide-eyed, patents and sketches spread out like he's planning a heist. But here's the kicker: his genius idea? Someone beat him to the punch. Patented it months ago. 

Told him the score, kept it straight. The way I see it, there's always a bigger fish in this town. He takes it on the chin, asks me what he’s supposed to do now. Had to remind him, in this game, originality’s just the start. You gotta hustle, stay a step ahead. Not everyone’s cut out for it, but he seemed to understand.产业链委会
